name: HEMM
description: A comprehensive benchmark suite to systematically evaluate multimodal foundation models across three dimensions: basic multimodal skills, information flow, and real-world use cases, covering 30 tasks to assess capabilities such as reasoning, alignment, and external knowledge handling.
reputation: A recent arXiv benchmark that is gaining attention as a broad multimodal evaluation suite, but it is not yet a long-established community standard.
notes: Evaluates multimodal models on skills, information flow, and real-world use cases; provides insights on model scale, pre-training, and instruction tuning.
